note: 閉じ込める is directly glossed as imprison or lock up, and the English definition explicitly includes confinement against someone's will.
色素 and sắc tố both mean biological pigment here; the English definition limits the sense to color in plant or animal cells.
坊主 can sound colloquial or disrespectful. 僧侶 is the neutral Japanese word for a Buddhist priest or monk and is glossed as bonze in JMdict (ent_seq 1398240 sense 0).
芯 has a direct wick sense, and bấc is the Vietnamese term for porous material carrying liquid by capillary action.
くり and hạt dẻ are the standard equivalents for edible chestnuts; the English definition itself also includes related or similar chestnut nuts.
もてなし expresses the service or act of welcoming and hosting, while lòng mến khách is a standard Vietnamese equivalent for a hospitable attitude.
Nghĩa đen names the literal meaning as a noun phrase. Theo nghĩa đen functions as the natural Vietnamese modifier for something understood literally rather than figuratively.
Máy xay is a general grinder. Máy xay sinh tố is the usual Vietnamese term for the countertop appliance that crushes or liquefies food ingredients.
Cù lao usually means an islet in a river or estuary. Đảo nhỏ is the neutral Vietnamese equivalent for a small island in any setting.
家政婦 and bà quản gia suggest a hired female domestic worker. 主婦 and người nội trợ better express the person managing a household, traditionally its female head.
Dĩa means a plate or disk generally. Đĩa ném specifies the flat disk thrown as an athletic event.
差出人 is specifically a mail or parcel sender. 送り手 means sender generally in JMdict (ent_seq 1709610 sense 0).
ダビング can also mean copying or re-recording media. 吹き替え specifically means film dubbing into another language in JMdict (ent_seq 1602490 sense 0).
なんと and không ngờ are natural functional equivalents for expressing that something is surprisingly unexpected, even though both commonly occur in larger clauses.
雀 ordinarily denotes the tree sparrow, while this English definition is explicitly the full Passeridae family; no verified broader Japanese headword was available in the offline lookup.
カヌー is exact, and xuồng is a natural Vietnamese equivalent for a small open paddle-propelled boat in this canoe sense.
円弧 means a circular arc only. 弧 means an arc generally in JMdict (ent_seq 1956240 sense 0), matching arcs of circles or other curves.
Tạp chủng can carry a negative mongrel connotation. Con lai is a neutral Vietnamese term for offspring from cross-breeding different species or strains.
Báo can refer to several spotted big cats. Báo hoa mai specifically names the leopard Panthera pardus.
Khí đốt means fuel gas generally. Khí thiên nhiên specifies the natural-gas mixture associated with petroleum deposits.
幼虫 and ấu trùng both mean an immature insect stage or larva, matching the grub definition, especially its beetle example.
素晴らしい means wonderful generally. 壮麗 means magnificent, grand, or splendid in JMdict (ent_seq 1399450 sense 0), fitting the appearance-focused definition.
Cánh quạt alone can mean ordinary fan blades. Cánh quạt đẩy specifies blades that propel an aircraft or boat through air or water.
Japanese distinguishes small hail as あられ and larger hail as 雹; neither single term covers the English definition's hail of any size.

revision.vi: nữ nhân viên phục vụ bàn

note: Chị hầu bàn is a descriptive, informal phrase. Nữ nhân viên phục vụ bàn is a more standard Vietnamese job-title equivalent for a female restaurant server.
くじ includes any drawing of lots or raffle. 宝くじ specifically means lottery in JMdict (ent_seq 1516170 sense 0).
Vạn is correct but less common in modern neutral Vietnamese. Mười nghìn is the ordinary cardinal expression for 10,000.
Lò bánh mì suggests a bread oven or bread-only bakery. Tiệm bánh covers a shop baking or selling bread and other baked goods.

revision.vi: người chưa từng quan hệ tình dục

note: 処女 and trinh nữ are female-specific. These descriptive forms name a person without prior sexual intercourse regardless of gender; the rare animal-mating extension is not the ordinary person sense.
ジャー is less natural for an ordinary preserves or storage jar. 瓶 means bottle or jar in JMdict (ent_seq 1491120 sense 0).
暖炉 and lò sưởi are direct equivalents for an open hearth or fireplace at the base of a chimney.
債務者 is formal and con nợ is colloquial. Bên nợ is a neutral Vietnamese term for the person or firm that owes money.
Thang may mean a ladder or stairs generally. Thang leo specifies the climbing tool in this definition.
キャンディ and kẹo are common equivalents for a piece of confectionery; the English wording specifies an individual piece.
ディーラー can mean a financial dealer in securities contexts as well as a car dealer; the stock-trading definition supplies that context.
Còi máy is uncommon and unclear. Còi hú is the standard Vietnamese term for a siren that sounds a piercing alarm.
Khoảng trống means an empty space generally. Ô trống is the specific blank field in a form or template.
割り振る means assign or distribute generally. 割り当てる is directly glossed allocate in JMdict (ent_seq 1207880 sense 0) and is standard for allocating program memory.
暖まる means get warm generally. 暖機 means warming up an engine in JMdict (ent_seq 2056080 sense 0), matching normal operating temperature for a car.
Nhãn means a label generally. Nhãn dán specifies an adhesive label or decal.
